test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 14 persons can complete (5)/(12) part of a work in 18 days, working 7 hours daily. How many hours working daily will 21 persons complete the rest of the work in 15 days?
solution:
**Given:**

14 persons can complete 5/12 of a work in 18 days, working 7 hours daily

21 persons need to complete the rest of the work in 15 days

**Concept:**

M₁D₁H₁/W₁ = M₂D₂H₂/W₂

**Solution:**

According to question,

If 14 persons complete 5 part of the work then remaining work is 7 part.

(14 × 18 × 7)/5 = (21 × 15 × H)/7

⇒ H = 196/25 = 721over25** **hours

 

**Therefore, they will need to work for approximately 721over25 hours daily to complete the rest of the work in 15 days.**
